# usva.
> Open-source React design system. Beautiful yet usable. Dual-distributed: npm package (@matt-pasek/usva) and shadcn-compatible registry (usva.dev/r/<name>.json).

## Install
- Package: bun add @matt-pasek/usva
- Registry: npx shadcn add https://usva.dev/r/button.json

## Components
Button, Badge, Card, Input, Tooltip (Phase 0).
